// Adds creationdate (text, as Flash tools wrote it) and metadatadate (an
// AMF date) to the onMetaData array of an FLV file made by ffmpeg. The
// script tag grows; the tags after it follow one another by size, so
// they read as before.
//
// Usage: go run flvdate.go <in.flv> <out.flv> <creationdate text> <metadatadate RFC 3339>
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/binary"
	"math"
	"os"
	"time"
)

func main() {
	in, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	md, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, os.Args[4])
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	at := int(binary.BigEndian.Uint32(in[5:])) + 4 // the first tag
	if in[at] != 18 {
		panic("the first tag isn't script data")
	}
	n := int(in[at+1])<<16 | int(in[at+2])<<8 | int(in[at+3])
	data := bytes.Clone(in[at+11 : at+11+n])
	// "onMetaData" (2 + 2 + 10), then the ECMA array: 0x08, a count.
	arr := 13
	if data[arr] != 8 {
		panic("onMetaData isn't an ECMA array")
	}
	end := bytes.LastIndex(data, []byte{0, 0, 9})
	var add []byte
	key := func(k string) { add = append(binary.BigEndian.AppendUint16(add, uint16(len(k))), k...) }
	key("creationdate")
	add = append(add, 2)
	add = append(binary.BigEndian.AppendUint16(add, uint16(len(os.Args[3]))), os.Args[3]...)
	key("metadatadate")
	add = append(add, 11)
	add = binary.BigEndian.AppendUint64(add, math.Float64bits(float64(md.UnixMilli())))
	add = append(add, 0, 0) // the time zone, unused
	data = append(append(data[:end:end], add...), 0, 0, 9)
	binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(data[arr+1:], binary.BigEndian.Uint32(data[arr+1:])+2)
	tag := bytes.Clone(in[at : at+11])
	tag[1], tag[2], tag[3] = byte(len(data)>>16), byte(len(data)>>8), byte(len(data))
	out := append(append(append(bytes.Clone(in[:at]), tag...), data...), binary.BigEndian.AppendUint32(nil, uint32(11+len(data)))...)
	out = append(out, in[at+11+n+4:]...)
	if err := os.WriteFile(os.Args[2], out, 0o644); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
